Let me describe my workflow with my cohorts as follows

I discuss with Mary the Project Brief and overall goal of the project
Then I discuss with Jason the Product Requirements
Then I ask Watson to design an Architecture that will deliver and support the product requirements
Then I iterate between Jason and Watson until they are synced and aligned with their respective documentation.
Then Jason will write out stories for development. Stories are drawn from the features and how they are intended to work. 
I as Eunice to make an overall Design System with color scheme, theme, and UI/UX thought design. Then Eunice makes a wireframe to encompass or implement every story designed so far. 
Then I ask Poe to create task shards for development based on Architecture, Stories, and UI/UX Wireframes. Shards Go into the backlog
Then I ask Quinn to make an initial test suite 
Then Athena or agent will proceed with development. When Athena finishes development the Backlog is updated. Development will include testing against the test suite
Then I ask Quinn to refine and improve the test suite based on actual developed code. 

If there are new features, I start again with Jason and progress from there. 
If the project has changed direction then I discuss again with Mary and proceed from there.
